eu5ab_gui_layout_toggle = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = { OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_layout_has_results has_variable = eu5ab_layout_ready } }
    is_valid = { OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_layout_has_results has_variable = eu5ab_layout_ready } }
    effect = {
        remove_variable = eu5ab_layout_show_candidates
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_layout_show_new } remove_variable = eu5ab_layout_show_new }
        else = { set_variable = eu5ab_layout_show_new }
    }
}

eu5ab_gui_layout_previous = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = { OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_layout_has_results has_variable = eu5ab_layout_ready } }
    is_valid = { var:eu5ab_layout_page > 0 }
    effect = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_layout_page subtract = 1 } eu5ab_layout_refresh_page = yes }
}

    is_valid = { var:eu5ab_layout_page < { value = var:eu5ab_layout_page_count subtract = 1 } }
    effect = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_layout_page add = 1 } eu5ab_layout_refresh_page = yes }
